# Homelab Infrastructure

OpenTofu-managed homelab on Proxmox. All commands run from local machine.

## Quick Reference

```bash
# OpenTofu workflow
task tofu:init APP=dashboards
task tofu:plan APP=dashboards
task tofu:apply APP=dashboards

# Utility commands
task tofu:ssh APP=dashboards           # SSH to LXC
task tofu:sync:compose APP=dashboards  # Sync compose files
task tofu:logs APP=dashboards SERVICE=homepage

# Desktop LXC (temporary GUI for downloads)
task desktop:create
task desktop:info
task desktop:destroy

# Backup operations
task backup:status                 # View backup status
task backup:now APP=immich         # Manual backup
task backup:all                    # Backup all containers
task backup:list APP=immich        # List backups
task backup:restore BACKUP=file TARGET_ID=305
task backup:immich:db              # Dump Immich database

# IP address management
task ip:next                       # Get next available IP for new LXC
task ip:list                       # Show all allocated IPs
```

## Architecture

- **Proxmox Host**: 192.168.1.215 (SSH: `ssh root@homelab`)
- **Traefik LXC**: 192.168.1.162 (ID: 200)
- **Monitoring LXC**: 192.168.1.229 (ID: 500)
- **IaC**: OpenTofu with bpg/proxmox provider
- **Secrets**: 1Password CLI (`op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"`)

## Documentation

- **[MIGRATION.md](tofu/MIGRATION.md)** - Guide for migrating apps to docker-lxc module pattern
- **[CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)** - This file (project overview and quick reference)

## Project Structure

```text
tofu/
├── MIGRATION.md       # Migration guide for docker-lxc pattern
├── apps/              # Per-app configs with own state
│   ├── dashboards/    # Homepage + Dashy (ID: 201)
│   ├── immich/        # Photo management (ID: 304)
│   ├── monitoring/    # Prometheus + Grafana + Alerting (ID: 500)
│   ├── network-services/  # AdGuard DNS (ID: 101)
│   ├── openwebui/     # AI chat (ID: 501)
│   ├── portainer/     # Container UI (ID: 100)
│   └── traefik/       # Reverse proxy (ID: 200)
├── configs/traefik/dynamic/  # Generated route configs
├── modules/           # Reusable modules
└── shared.tf          # Common vars (symlinked)
```

## Key Modules

- **lxc-base**: Base LXC container with static IP support
- **docker-host**: LXC + Docker + compose deployment
- **file-sync**: Rsync file transfers to LXCs
- **proxmox-notes**: Update LXC description in Proxmox UI

## IP Address Management

All static IPs are tracked in `tofu/ip-registry.tf` (symlinked to all apps).

### IP Ranges

| Range | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| 192.168.1.1-99 | Infrastructure (router, Proxmox, switches) |
| 192.168.1.100-149 | Core services (Traefik, Portainer, DNS) |
| 192.168.1.150-199 | LXC containers (apps) - **preferred for new deployments** |
| 192.168.1.200-224 | Reserved for manual/temporary use |
| 192.168.1.225-254 | Special services & overflow |

### Deploying a New Service

1. Get the next available IP:

   ```bash
   task ip:next
   # Output: Next available IP: 192.168.1.150
   # For lxc-base module: ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
   ```

2. Add the IP to `tofu/ip-registry.tf`:

   ```hcl
   apps = {
     # ... existing entries ...
     my_new_service = "192.168.1.150"  # LXC XXX - Description
   }
   ```

3. Use in your app's main.tf:

   ```hcl
   module "lxc" {
     source = "../../modules/lxc-base"
     # ...
     ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
     gateway    = "192.168.1.1"
   }
   ```

### Viewing All Allocations

```bash
task ip:list
```

## Network Domains

- `*.homelab.rambtech.dev` - Internal (Traefik websecure)
- `*.rambtech.dev` - Public (Cloudflare tunnel via web entrypoint)

## Monitoring Stack

The monitoring LXC (ID: 500, IP: 192.168.1.229) runs:

| Component | Port | Purpose |
|-----------|------|---------|
| OpenTelemetry Collector | 4317/4318 | OTLP receiver (gRPC/HTTP) |
| Prometheus | 9090 | Metrics storage + alerting |
| Alertmanager | 9093 | Alert routing (ntfy + Discord) |
| Grafana | 3000 | Dashboards |
| Uptime Kuma | 3001 | HTTP monitoring |
| ntfy | 8080 | Push notifications |

### Key URLs

- Grafana: `https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Prometheus: `https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Alertmanager: `https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Uptime Kuma: `https://status.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- ntfy: `https://ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev`

### Syncing Monitoring Config

```bash
rsync -avz tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/ root@192.168.1.229:/config/
ssh root@192.168.1.229 "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
```

## 1Password Integration

Secrets are managed via the 1Password OpenTofu provider (`1password/onepassword`).

### Key Files

- `tofu/onepassword.tf` - Data sources + `local.op` helper (symlinked to apps)
- `tofu/versions.tf` - Provider configs using `local.op.*`

### Available Secrets

```hcl
local.op.proxmox_api_token       # Proxmox API authentication
local.op.cloudflare_api_token    # Cloudflare DNS/tunnel API
local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token # Cloudflare tunnel token
local.op.grafana_admin_password  # Grafana admin password
local.op.discord_webhook_url     # Discord alertmanager webhook
```

### Adding New Secrets

1. Create item in 1Password `homelab` vault
2. Add data source to `tofu/onepassword.tf`:

   ```hcl
   data "onepassword_item" "myservice" {
     vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
     title = "myservice"
   }
   ```

3. Add to `local.op` map in same file:

   ```hcl
   op = {
     myservice_password = data.onepassword_item.myservice.password
     # For section fields, flatten first then lookup:
     myservice_api_key = lookup(local._myservice_fields, "api_key", "")
   }
   ```

4. Use in modules: `local.op.myservice_password`

### Field Access Patterns

```hcl
# Main password field
data.onepassword_item.myitem.password

# Credential field (API keys)
data.onepassword_item.myitem.credential

# Custom fields in sections (must flatten):
locals {
  _myitem_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.myitem.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)
}
# Then: lookup(local._myitem_fields, "field_label", "")
```

### Why TF_VAR for State Encryption

State encryption runs before providers initialize, so it cannot use the 1Password provider:

```yaml
# Taskfile.yml
env:
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"
```

### 1Password Items (homelab vault)

| Item | Fields |
|------|--------|
| `opentofu` | password, proxmox_api_token (section) |
| `Cloudflare` | tunnel_token, ddns_api_token (sections) |
| `grafana` | password |
| `discord-alertmanager-webhook` | credential |

## Important Notes

- SSH to Proxmox: `ssh root@homelab`
- SSH to Monitoring: `ssh root@192.168.1.229`
- Use IP addresses in provisioners (not hostnames)
- State files are encrypted and committed to git
- Each app has independent state in `tofu/apps/<app>/`
- 1Password CLI v2.23.0+ required (uses biometric auth)

1→# Homelab OpenTofu Architecture
     2→
     3→Modern, self-contained app deployment pattern with zero symlinks and self-service routing.
     4→
     5→## Architecture Diagrams
     6→
     7→PlantUML diagrams for visualizing the infrastructure:
     8→
     9→| Diagram | Description |
    10→|---------|-------------|
    11→| [network-architecture.puml](network-architecture.puml) | Full network topology with all LXCs, IPs, and connections |
    12→| [service-map.puml](service-map.puml) | Service-to-domain mapping and container overview |
    13→| [traffic-flow.puml](traffic-flow.puml) | Request flow for public, internal, and direct LAN access |
    14→
    15→To render: Use PlantUML extension in VSCode, or paste into [plantuml.com](https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml/uml/)
    16→
    17→## Module Ecosystem
    18→
    19→### Core Modules
    20→
    21→| Module | Purpose | Replaces |
    22→|--------|---------|----------|
    23→| **common** | Shared resources (1Password, IP registry, variables) | 44 symlinked files |
    24→| **docker-lxc** | Complete Docker app deployment (LXC + Docker + files) | Manual LXC + provisioners |
    25→| **traefik-route** | Self-service Traefik route registration | Manual YAML editing |
    26→| **cloudflare-tunnel** | Self-service public DNS registration | Manual Cloudflare dashboard |
    27→
    28→### Supporting Modules
    29→
    30→| Module | Purpose |
    31→|--------|---------|
    32→| **lxc-base** | Base LXC container with static IP |
    33→| **file-sync** | Rsync file transfers to remote hosts |
    34→| **proxmox-notes** | Update LXC description in Proxmox UI |
    35→
    36→## The Golden Pattern
    37→
    38→A complete, self-contained app deployment:
    39→
    40→```hcl
    41→# 1. Shared resources (no symlinks!)
    42→module "common" {
    43→  source = "../../modules/common"
    44→}
    45→
    46→# 2. Deploy app LXC with Docker
    47→module "myapp" {
    48→  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"
    49→
    50→  name         = "myapp"
    51→  container_id = 150
    52→
    53→  ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
    54→  gateway    = module.common.network.gateway
    55→
    56→  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"
    57→
    58→  ssh_private_key_path = module.common.ssh_private_key_path
    59→  ssh_public_key       = module.common.ssh_public_key
    60→  template             = module.common.lxc_template_docker
    61→
    62→  # ... other config
    63→}
    64→
    65→# 3. Self-register Traefik routes
    66→module "myapp_route" {
    67→  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"
    68→
    69→  app_name    = "myapp"
    70→  backend_url = "http://${module.myapp.ip_address}:8080"
    71→
    72→  internal_domain = "myapp.${module.common.domain_internal}"
    73→  public_domain   = "myapp.${module.common.domain_public}"  # Optional
    74→
    75→  traefik_host         = "192.168.1.162"
    76→  ssh_private_key_path = module.common.ssh_private_key_path
    77→
    78→  depends_on = [module.myapp]
    79→}
    80→
    81→# 4. Self-register public DNS (optional)
    82→module "myapp_tunnel" {
    83→  source = "../../modules/cloudflare-tunnel"
    84→
    85→  hostname    = "myapp"
    86→  domain      = module.common.domain_public
    87→  backend_url = "http://192.168.1.162"  # Traefik
    88→  tunnel_id   = module.common.op.cloudflare_tunnel_id
    89→
    90→  depends_on = [module.myapp_route]
    91→}
    92→```
    93→
    94→## What This Achieves
    95→
    96→### ✅ Self-Contained Apps
    97→
    98→Each app directory contains **everything** needed:
    99→- `main.tf` - Complete app definition
   100→- `deploy/` - Docker compose + configs
   101→
   102→No symlinks, no manual Traefik edits, no Cloudflare dashboard.
   103→
   104→### ✅ Declarative Networking
   105→
   106→```hcl
   107→# App says "I want to be accessible at these URLs"
   108→internal_domain = "myapp.homelab.rambtech.dev"
   109→public_domain   = "myapp.rambtech.dev"
   110→
   111→# Infrastructure automatically:
   112→# 1. Creates Traefik routes
   113→# 2. Syncs configs to Traefik LXC
   114→# 3. Reloads Traefik
   115→# 4. Creates Cloudflare DNS
   116→# 5. Updates Proxmox notes
   117→```
   118→
   119→### ✅ Single Source of Truth

# Homelab OpenTofu Architecture

Modern, self-contained app deployment pattern with zero symlinks and self-service routing.

## Architecture Diagrams

PlantUML diagrams for visualizing the infrastructure:

| Diagram | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [network-architecture.puml](network-architecture.puml) | Full network topology with all LXCs, IPs, and connections |
| [service-map.puml](service-map.puml) | Service-to-domain mapping and container overview |
| [traffic-flow.puml](traffic-flow.puml) | Request flow for public, internal, and direct LAN access |

To render: Use PlantUML extension in VSCode, or paste into [plantuml.com](https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml/uml/)

## Module Ecosystem

### Core Modules

| Module | Purpose | Replaces |
|--------|---------|----------|
| **common** | Shared resources (1Password, IP registry, variables) | 44 symlinked files |
| **docker-lxc** | Complete Docker app deployment (LXC + Docker + files) | Manual LXC + provisioners |
| **traefik-route** | Self-service Traefik route registration | Manual YAML editing |
| **cloudflare-tunnel** | Self-service public DNS registration | Manual Cloudflare dashboard |

### Supporting Modules

| Module | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| **lxc-base** | Base LXC container with static IP |
| **file-sync** | Rsync file transfers to remote hosts |
| **proxmox-notes** | Update LXC description in Proxmox UI |

## The Golden Pattern

A complete, self-contained app deployment:

```hcl
# 1. Shared resources (no symlinks!)
module "common" {
  source = "../../modules/common"
}

# 2. Deploy app LXC with Docker
module "myapp" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "myapp"
  container_id = 150

  ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
  gateway    = module.common.network.gateway

  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  ssh_private_key_path = module.common.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = module.common.ssh_public_key
  template             = module.common.lxc_template_docker

  # ... other config
}

# 3. Self-register Traefik routes
module "myapp_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "myapp"
  backend_url = "http://${module.myapp.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "myapp.${module.common.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "myapp.${module.common.domain_public}"  # Optional

  traefik_host         = "192.168.1.162"
  ssh_private_key_path = module.common.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.myapp]
}

# 4. Self-register public DNS (optional)
module "myapp_tunnel" {
  source = "../../modules/cloudflare-tunnel"

  hostname    = "myapp"
  domain      = module.common.domain_public
  backend_url = "http://192.168.1.162"  # Traefik
  tunnel_id   = module.common.op.cloudflare_tunnel_id

  depends_on = [module.myapp_route]
}
```

## What This Achieves

### ✅ Self-Contained Apps

Each app directory contains **everything** needed:
- `main.tf` - Complete app definition
- `deploy/` - Docker compose + configs

No symlinks, no manual Traefik edits, no Cloudflare dashboard.

### ✅ Declarative Networking

```hcl
# App says "I want to be accessible at these URLs"
internal_domain = "myapp.homelab.rambtech.dev"
public_domain   = "myapp.rambtech.dev"

# Infrastructure automatically:
# 1. Creates Traefik routes
# 2. Syncs configs to Traefik LXC
# 3. Reloads Traefik
# 4. Creates Cloudflare DNS
# 5. Updates Proxmox notes
```

### ✅ Single Source of Truth

- **IP registry** in common module
- **Secrets** from 1Password via common module
- **Routes** defined in app, not scattered across Traefik configs
- **DNS** defined in app, not Cloudflare dashboard

### ✅ Clean Directory Structure

**Before (with symlinks):**
```
tofu/apps/myapp/
├── main.tf
├── deploy/
├── shared.tf -> ../../shared.tf
├── onepassword.tf -> ../../onepassword.tf
├── ip-registry.tf -> ../../ip-registry.tf
└── versions.tf -> ../../versions.tf
```

**After (with common module):**
```
tofu/apps/myapp/
├── main.tf       # Just one file!
└── deploy/
```

## Traffic Flow

### Internal Access (HTTPS)

```
User Browser
   ↓
https://myapp.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ↓
Traefik (192.168.1.162)
   ↓ Let's Encrypt TLS
http://192.168.1.150:8080  # App LXC
```

### Public Access (HTTPS)

```
Internet User
   ↓
https://myapp.rambtech.dev
   ↓
Cloudflare Edge (TLS termination)
   ↓
Cloudflare Tunnel
   ↓
Traefik (192.168.1.162) - HTTP
   ↓
http://192.168.1.150:8080  # App LXC
```

## Deployment Workflow

### New App Deployment

```bash
# 1. Get next available IP
task ip:next
# Output: 192.168.1.150

# 2. Create app directory
mkdir -p tofu/apps/myapp/deploy

# 3. Write main.tf using golden pattern

# 4. Write docker-compose.yml in deploy/

# 5. Update IP registry in common module
# tofu/modules/common/main.tf:
#   myapp = "192.168.1.150"

# 6. Deploy
task tofu:init APP=myapp
task tofu:plan APP=myapp
task tofu:apply APP=myapp

# Done! App is:
# - Running in LXC
# - Accessible at myapp.homelab.rambtech.dev
# - Optionally public at myapp.rambtech.dev
# - Documented in Proxmox notes
```

### Update App Configuration

```bash
# 1. Edit deploy/docker-compose.yml or other files
vim tofu/apps/myapp/deploy/docker-compose.yml

# 2. Apply changes
task tofu:apply APP=myapp

# file-sync module auto-syncs changed files
# remote-docker-compose provider auto-restarts containers
```

### Change Routes

```hcl
# Edit main.tf
module "myapp_route" {
  # ...
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "rate-limit"]  # Added
}

# Apply
task tofu:apply APP=myapp

# Traefik config auto-updated and reloaded
```

## Migration Path

### Phase 1: Create Core Modules ✅

- [x] common module (replaces symlinks)
- [x] docker-lxc module (gold standard)
- [x] traefik-route module (self-service routing)
- [x] cloudflare-tunnel module (self-service DNS)

### Phase 2: Migrate One App (n8n)

1. Update n8n/main.tf to use common module
2. Add traefik-route module
3. Add cloudflare-tunnel module (if public)
4. Test thoroughly
5. Remove symlinks

### Phase 3: Migrate Remaining Apps

Use n8n as template for:
- authelia
- dashboards
- immich
- immich-importer
- jellyfin
- media-management
- monitoring
- openwebui
- portainer

### Phase 4: Migrate Traefik (Complex)

Traefik is special (doesn't run Docker currently):
- Use lxc-base + file-sync modules
- Keep existing manual setup initially
- Gradually adopt new patterns

### Phase 5: Cleanup

1. Delete `tofu/shared.tf`
2. Delete `tofu/onepassword.tf`
3. Delete `tofu/ip-registry.tf`
4. Delete `tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/*.yml` (now auto-generated)
5. Update CLAUDE.md documentation

## Benefits Summary

### Code Reduction

- **44 symlinks** → 0 symlinks
- **186 lines** per app → **96 lines** per app (48% reduction)
- **Manual Traefik configs** → Auto-generated from app definition
- **Manual Cloudflare DNS** → Auto-created from app definition

### Developer Experience

- **One file** to understand app deployment
- **No context switching** between Traefik/Cloudflare/app
- **Clear dependencies** via module structure
- **Self-documenting** architecture

### Operational Excellence

- **Single source of truth** for all app config
- **Atomic updates** via Terraform state
- **Rollback friendly** (destroy and recreate)
- **Testable** (each module independently testable)

## Best Practices

### 1. Always Use Common Module

```hcl
module "common" {
  source = "../../modules/common"
}
```

Never hardcode values that common module provides.

### 2. Use docker-lxc for Docker Apps

Don't use lxc-base + manual Docker setup. The docker-lxc module is the gold standard.

### 3. Self-Register Routes

Every app should include its traefik-route module. Don't manually edit Traefik configs.

### 4. Declare Public Access Explicitly

```hcl
# Clear intent: this app is public
public_domain = "myapp.rambtech.dev"

module "myapp_tunnel" { ... }
```

### 5. Document Custom Notes

Use `custom_notes` in docker-lxc for app-specific instructions:

```hcl
custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Special Configuration

This app requires manual SSL cert installation:
```
ssh root@${module.myapp.ip_address}
# ... steps
```
EOT
```

## Future Enhancements

- **Auto-discovery** of app changes (watch docker-compose.yml)
- **Multi-backend** Traefik routes (load balancing)
- **Auto-scaling** based on metrics
- **Backup automation** via module
- **Testing framework** for modules
- **VS Code snippets** for golden pattern

# Homelab Infrastructure

OpenTofu-managed homelab on Proxmox. All commands run from local machine.

## Quick Reference

```bash
# OpenTofu workflow
task tofu:init APP=dashboards
task tofu:plan APP=dashboards
task tofu:apply APP=dashboards

# Utility commands
task tofu:ssh APP=dashboards           # SSH to LXC
task tofu:sync:compose APP=dashboards  # Sync compose files
task tofu:logs APP=dashboards SERVICE=homepage

# Desktop LXC (temporary GUI for downloads)
task desktop:create
task desktop:info
task desktop:destroy

# Backup operations
task backup:status                 # View backup status
task backup:now APP=immich         # Manual backup
task backup:all                    # Backup all containers
task backup:list APP=immich        # List backups
task backup:restore BACKUP=file TARGET_ID=305
task backup:immich:db              # Dump Immich database

# IP address management
task ip:next                       # Get next available IP for new LXC
task ip:list                       # Show all allocated IPs
```

## Architecture

- **Proxmox Host**: 192.168.1.215 (SSH: `ssh root@homelab`)
- **Traefik LXC**: 192.168.1.162 (ID: 200)
- **Monitoring LXC**: 192.168.1.229 (ID: 500)
- **IaC**: OpenTofu with bpg/proxmox provider
- **Secrets**: 1Password CLI (`op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"`)

## Documentation

- **[MIGRATION.md](tofu/MIGRATION.md)** - Guide for migrating apps to docker-lxc module pattern
- **[CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)** - This file (project overview and quick reference)

## Project Structure

```text
tofu/
├── MIGRATION.md       # Migration guide for docker-lxc pattern
├── apps/              # Per-app configs with own state
│   ├── dashboards/    # Homepage + Dashy (ID: 201)
│   ├── immich/        # Photo management (ID: 304)
│   ├── monitoring/    # Prometheus + Grafana + Alerting (ID: 500)
│   ├── network-services/  # AdGuard DNS (ID: 101)
│   ├── openwebui/     # AI chat (ID: 501)
│   ├── portainer/     # Container UI (ID: 100)
│   └── traefik/       # Reverse proxy (ID: 200)
├── configs/traefik/dynamic/  # Generated route configs
├── modules/           # Reusable modules
└── shared.tf          # Common vars (symlinked)
```

## Key Modules

- **lxc-base**: Base LXC container with static IP support
- **docker-host**: LXC + Docker + compose deployment
- **file-sync**: Rsync file transfers to LXCs
- **proxmox-notes**: Update LXC description in Proxmox UI

## IP Address Management

All static IPs are tracked in `tofu/ip-registry.tf` (symlinked to all apps).

### IP Ranges

| Range | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| 192.168.1.1-99 | Infrastructure (router, Proxmox, switches) |
| 192.168.1.100-149 | Core services (Traefik, Portainer, DNS) |
| 192.168.1.150-199 | LXC containers (apps) - **preferred for new deployments** |
| 192.168.1.200-224 | Reserved for manual/temporary use |
| 192.168.1.225-254 | Special services & overflow |

### Deploying a New Service

1. Get the next available IP:

   ```bash
   task ip:next
   # Output: Next available IP: 192.168.1.150
   # For lxc-base module: ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
   ```

2. Add the IP to `tofu/ip-registry.tf`:

   ```hcl
   apps = {
     # ... existing entries ...
     my_new_service = "192.168.1.150"  # LXC XXX - Description
   }
   ```

3. Use in your app's main.tf:

   ```hcl
   module "lxc" {
     source = "../../modules/lxc-base"
     # ...
     ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
     gateway    = "192.168.1.1"
   }
   ```

### Viewing All Allocations

```bash
task ip:list
```

## Network Domains

- `*.homelab.rambtech.dev` - Internal (Traefik websecure)
- `*.rambtech.dev` - Public (Cloudflare tunnel via web entrypoint)

## Monitoring Stack

The monitoring LXC (ID: 500, IP: 192.168.1.229) runs:

| Component | Port | Purpose |
|-----------|------|---------|
| OpenTelemetry Collector | 4317/4318 | OTLP receiver (gRPC/HTTP) |
| Prometheus | 9090 | Metrics storage + alerting |
| Alertmanager | 9093 | Alert routing (ntfy + Discord) |
| Grafana | 3000 | Dashboards |
| Uptime Kuma | 3001 | HTTP monitoring |
| ntfy | 8080 | Push notifications |

### Key URLs

- Grafana: `https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Prometheus: `https://prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Alertmanager: `https://alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- Uptime Kuma: `https://status.homelab.rambtech.dev`
- ntfy: `https://ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev`

### Syncing Monitoring Config

```bash
rsync -avz tofu/apps/monitoring/deploy/ root@192.168.1.229:/config/
ssh root@192.168.1.229 "cd /config && docker compose up -d"
```

## 1Password Integration

Secrets are managed via the 1Password OpenTofu provider (`1password/onepassword`).

### Key Files

- `tofu/onepassword.tf` - Data sources + `local.op` helper (symlinked to apps)
- `tofu/versions.tf` - Provider configs using `local.op.*`

### Available Secrets

```hcl
local.op.proxmox_api_token       # Proxmox API authentication
local.op.cloudflare_api_token    # Cloudflare DNS/tunnel API
local.op.cloudflare_tunnel_token # Cloudflare tunnel token
local.op.grafana_admin_password  # Grafana admin password
local.op.discord_webhook_url     # Discord alertmanager webhook
```

### Adding New Secrets

1. Create item in 1Password `homelab` vault
2. Add data source to `tofu/onepassword.tf`:

   ```hcl
   data "onepassword_item" "myservice" {
     vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
     title = "myservice"
   }
   ```

3. Add to `local.op` map in same file:

   ```hcl
   op = {
     myservice_password = data.onepassword_item.myservice.password
     # For section fields, flatten first then lookup:
     myservice_api_key = lookup(local._myservice_fields, "api_key", "")
   }
   ```

4. Use in modules: `local.op.myservice_password`

### Field Access Patterns

```hcl
# Main password field
data.onepassword_item.myitem.password

# Credential field (API keys)
data.onepassword_item.myitem.credential

# Custom fields in sections (must flatten):
locals {
  _myitem_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.myitem.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)
}
# Then: lookup(local._myitem_fields, "field_label", "")
```

### Why TF_VAR for State Encryption

State encryption runs before providers initialize, so it cannot use the 1Password provider:

```yaml
# Taskfile.yml
env:
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"
```

### 1Password Items (homelab vault)

| Item | Fields |
|------|--------|
| `opentofu` | password, proxmox_api_token (section) |
| `Cloudflare` | tunnel_token, ddns_api_token (sections) |
| `grafana` | password |
| `discord-alertmanager-webhook` | credential |

## Important Notes

- SSH to Proxmox: `ssh root@homelab`
- SSH to Monitoring: `ssh root@192.168.1.229`
- Use IP addresses in provisioners (not hostnames)
- State files are encrypted and committed to git
- Each app has independent state in `tofu/apps/<app>/`
- 1Password CLI v2.23.0+ required (uses biometric auth)

# Homelab OpenTofu Architecture

Modern, self-contained app deployment pattern with zero symlinks and self-service routing.

## Architecture Diagrams

PlantUML diagrams for visualizing the infrastructure:

| Diagram | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [network-architecture.puml](network-architecture.puml) | Full network topology with all LXCs, IPs, and connections |
| [service-map.puml](service-map.puml) | Service-to-domain mapping and container overview |
| [traffic-flow.puml](traffic-flow.puml) | Request flow for public, internal, and direct LAN access |

To render: Use PlantUML extension in VSCode, or paste into [plantuml.com](https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml/uml/)

## Module Ecosystem

### Core Modules

| Module | Purpose | Replaces |
|--------|---------|----------|
| **common** | Shared resources (1Password, IP registry, variables) | 44 symlinked files |
| **docker-lxc** | Complete Docker app deployment (LXC + Docker + files) | Manual LXC + provisioners |
| **traefik-route** | Self-service Traefik route registration | Manual YAML editing |
| **cloudflare-tunnel** | Self-service public DNS registration | Manual Cloudflare dashboard |

### Supporting Modules

| Module | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| **lxc-base** | Base LXC container with static IP |
| **file-sync** | Rsync file transfers to remote hosts |
| **proxmox-notes** | Update LXC description in Proxmox UI |

## The Golden Pattern

A complete, self-contained app deployment:

```hcl
# 1. Shared resources (no symlinks!)
module "common" {
  source = "../../modules/common"
}

# 2. Deploy app LXC with Docker
module "myapp" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "myapp"
  container_id = 150

  ip_address = "192.168.1.150/24"
  gateway    = module.common.network.gateway

  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  ssh_private_key_path = module.common.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = module.common.ssh_public_key
  template             = module.common.lxc_template_docker

  # ... other config
}

# 3. Self-register Traefik routes
module "myapp_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "myapp"
  backend_url = "http://${module.myapp.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "myapp.${module.common.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "myapp.${module.common.domain_public}"  # Optional

  traefik_host         = "192.168.1.162"
  ssh_private_key_path = module.common.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.myapp]
}

# 4. Self-register public DNS (optional)
module "myapp_tunnel" {
  source = "../../modules/cloudflare-tunnel"

  hostname    = "myapp"
  domain      = module.common.domain_public
  backend_url = "http://192.168.1.162"  # Traefik
  tunnel_id   = module.common.op.cloudflare_tunnel_id

  depends_on = [module.myapp_route]
}
```

## What This Achieves

### ✅ Self-Contained Apps

Each app directory contains **everything** needed:
- `main.tf` - Complete app definition
- `deploy/` - Docker compose + configs

No symlinks, no manual Traefik edits, no Cloudflare dashboard.

### ✅ Declarative Networking

```hcl
# App says "I want to be accessible at these URLs"
internal_domain = "myapp.homelab.rambtech.dev"
public_domain   = "myapp.rambtech.dev"

# Infrastructure automatically:
# 1. Creates Traefik routes
# 2. Syncs configs to Traefik LXC
# 3. Reloads Traefik
# 4. Creates Cloudflare DNS
# 5. Updates Proxmox notes
```

### ✅ Single Source of Truth

- **IP registry** in common module
- **Secrets** from 1Password via common module
- **Routes** defined in app, not scattered across Traefik configs
- **DNS** defined in app, not Cloudflare dashboard

### ✅ Clean Directory Structure

**Before (with symlinks):**
```
tofu/apps/myapp/
├── main.tf
├── deploy/
├── shared.tf -> ../../shared.tf
├── onepassword.tf -> ../../onepassword.tf
├── ip-registry.tf -> ../../ip-registry.tf
└── versions.tf -> ../../versions.tf
```

**After (with common module):**
```
tofu/apps/myapp/
├── main.tf       # Just one file!
└── deploy/
```

## Traffic Flow

### Internal Access (HTTPS)

```
User Browser
   ↓
https://myapp.homelab.rambtech.dev
   ↓
Traefik (192.168.1.162)
   ↓ Let's Encrypt TLS
http://192.168.1.150:8080  # App LXC
```

### Public Access (HTTPS)

```
Internet User
   ↓
https://myapp.rambtech.dev
   ↓
Cloudflare Edge (TLS termination)
   ↓
Cloudflare Tunnel
   ↓
Traefik (192.168.1.162) - HTTP
   ↓
http://192.168.1.150:8080  # App LXC
```

## Deployment Workflow

### New App Deployment

```bash
# 1. Get next available IP
task ip:next
# Output: 192.168.1.150

# 2. Create app directory
mkdir -p tofu/apps/myapp/deploy

# 3. Write main.tf using golden pattern

# 4. Write docker-compose.yml in deploy/

# 5. Update IP registry in common module
# tofu/modules/common/main.tf:
#   myapp = "192.168.1.150"

# 6. Deploy
task tofu:init APP=myapp
task tofu:plan APP=myapp
task tofu:apply APP=myapp

# Done! App is:
# - Running in LXC
# - Accessible at myapp.homelab.rambtech.dev
# - Optionally public at myapp.rambtech.dev
# - Documented in Proxmox notes
```

### Update App Configuration

```bash
# 1. Edit deploy/docker-compose.yml or other files
vim tofu/apps/myapp/deploy/docker-compose.yml

# 2. Apply changes
task tofu:apply APP=myapp

# file-sync module auto-syncs changed files
# remote-docker-compose provider auto-restarts containers
```

### Change Routes

```hcl
# Edit main.tf
module "myapp_route" {
  # ...
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "rate-limit"]  # Added
}

# Apply
task tofu:apply APP=myapp

# Traefik config auto-updated and reloaded
```

## Migration Path

### Phase 1: Create Core Modules ✅

- [x] common module (replaces symlinks)
- [x] docker-lxc module (gold standard)
- [x] traefik-route module (self-service routing)
- [x] cloudflare-tunnel module (self-service DNS)

### Phase 2: Migrate One App (n8n)

1. Update n8n/main.tf to use common module
2. Add traefik-route module
3. Add cloudflare-tunnel module (if public)
4. Test thoroughly
5. Remove symlinks

### Phase 3: Migrate Remaining Apps

Use n8n as template for:
- authelia
- dashboards
- immich
- immich-importer
- jellyfin
- media-management
- monitoring
- openwebui
- portainer

### Phase 4: Migrate Traefik (Complex)

Traefik is special (doesn't run Docker currently):
- Use lxc-base + file-sync modules
- Keep existing manual setup initially
- Gradually adopt new patterns

### Phase 5: Cleanup

1. Delete `tofu/shared.tf`
2. Delete `tofu/onepassword.tf`
3. Delete `tofu/ip-registry.tf`
4. Delete `tofu/apps/traefik/deploy/dynamic/*.yml` (now auto-generated)
5. Update CLAUDE.md documentation

## Benefits Summary

### Code Reduction

- **44 symlinks** → 0 symlinks
- **186 lines** per app → **96 lines** per app (48% reduction)
- **Manual Traefik configs** → Auto-generated from app definition
- **Manual Cloudflare DNS** → Auto-created from app definition

### Developer Experience

- **One file** to understand app deployment
- **No context switching** between Traefik/Cloudflare/app
- **Clear dependencies** via module structure
- **Self-documenting** architecture

### Operational Excellence

- **Single source of truth** for all app config
- **Atomic updates** via Terraform state
- **Rollback friendly** (destroy and recreate)
- **Testable** (each module independently testable)

## Best Practices

### 1. Always Use Common Module

```hcl
module "common" {
  source = "../../modules/common"
}
```

Never hardcode values that common module provides.

### 2. Use docker-lxc for Docker Apps

Don't use lxc-base + manual Docker setup. The docker-lxc module is the gold standard.

### 3. Self-Register Routes

Every app should include its traefik-route module. Don't manually edit Traefik configs.

### 4. Declare Public Access Explicitly

```hcl
# Clear intent: this app is public
public_domain = "myapp.rambtech.dev"

module "myapp_tunnel" { ... }
```

### 5. Document Custom Notes

Use `custom_notes` in docker-lxc for app-specific instructions:

```hcl
custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Special Configuration

This app requires manual SSL cert installation:
```
ssh root@${module.myapp.ip_address}
# ... steps
```
EOT
```

## Future Enhancements

- **Auto-discovery** of app changes (watch docker-compose.yml)
- **Multi-backend** Traefik routes (load balancing)
- **Auto-scaling** based on metrics
- **Backup automation** via module
- **Testing framework** for modules
- **VS Code snippets** for golden pattern

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# =============================================================================
# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)
# =============================================================================
includes:
  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  backup:
    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  template:
    taskfile: ./tasks/template.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task tofu:apply APP=authelia' to deploy."

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")
        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"
        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"
        EOF

        echo "terraform.tfvars written to $TFVARS"

  immich-importer:cron:status:
    desc: "Show cron job status on immich-importer LXC"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- crontab -l"

  # ===========================================================================
  # IP Address Management
  # ===========================================================================

  ip:next:
    desc: "Show the next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/next.sh

  ip:list:

    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/list.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cleanup & Maintenance
  # ===========================================================================

  cleanup:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (dry run)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh

  cleanup:run:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (actually delete)"
    cmds:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Homepage - Main Dashboard
  # ==========================================================================
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage
    environment:
      PUID: 1000
      PGID: 1000
      TZ: America/New_York
      HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS: homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev,homepage.tailnet.rambtech.dev
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./homepage:/app/config
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Dashy - Alternative Dashboard
  # ==========================================================================
  dashy:
    image: lissy93/dashy:latest
    container_name: dashy
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      UID: 1000
      GID: 1000
    ports:
      - "4001:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./dashy:/app/user-data
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'node', '/app/services/healthcheck']
      interval: 1m30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Glances - System Monitoring API
  # ==========================================================================
  glances:
    image: nicolargo/glances:latest-full
    container_name: glances
    pid: host
    environment:
      - GLANCES_OPT=-w
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "61208:61208"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /proc:/host/proc:ro
      - /sys:/host/sys:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# =============================================================================
# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)
# =============================================================================
includes:
  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  backup:
    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  template:
    taskfile: ./tasks/template.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task tofu:apply APP=authelia' to deploy."

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")
        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"
        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"
        EOF

        echo "terraform.tfvars written to $TFVARS"

  immich-importer:cron:status:
    desc: "Show cron job status on immich-importer LXC"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- crontab -l"

  # ===========================================================================
  # IP Address Management
  # ===========================================================================

  ip:next:
    desc: "Show the next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/next.sh

  ip:list:
    desc: "Show all allocated IP addresses"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/list.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cleanup & Maintenance
  # ===========================================================================

  cleanup:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (dry run)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh

  cleanup:run:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (actually delete)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh --run

# Jellyfin Widget Configuration

Here's the complete widget configuration with all available options:

```yaml
widget:
  type: jellyfin
  url: http://jellyfin.host.or.ip
  key: apikeyapikeyapikeyapikeyapikey
  enableBlocks: true # optional, defaults to false
  enableNowPlaying: true # optional, defaults to true
  enableUser: true # optional, defaults to false
  enableMediaControl: false # optional, defaults to true
  showEpisodeNumber: true # optional, defaults to false
  expandOneStreamToTwoRows: false # optional, defaults to true
```

- Generate your API key via "Settings > Advanced > Api Keys" in Jellyfin
- The `enableBlocks` option activates fields for "movies", "series", "episodes", and "songs"
- The "Now Playing" feature is enabled by default but can be toggled
- Additional user and media control options are available for customization

# Portainer Widget Configuration

Based on the documentation, here's the complete Portainer widget configuration with all available options:

```yaml
widget:
  type: portainer
  url: https://portainer.host.or.ip:9443
  env: 1
  kubernetes: true # optional, defaults to false
  key: ptr_accesskeyaccesskeyaccesskeyaccesskey
```

## Key Configuration Details

**Required fields:**
- `type`: Must be set to `portainer`
- `url`: Your Portainer instance address
- `env`: Environment ID (find this in the URL as `#!/endpoints/1`, where `1` is your env value)
- `key`: API access key generated from Portainer

**Optional fields:**
- `kubernetes`: Set to `true` for Kubernetes mode; defaults to `false` for Docker mode

**Displayable metrics vary by mode:**
- Docker mode: "running", "stopped", "total"
- Kubernetes mode: "applications", "services", "namespaces"

You'll need to generate your API key by following Portainer's documentation at https://docs.portainer.io/api/access.

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Homepage - Main Dashboard
  # ==========================================================================
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage
    environment:
      PUID: 1000
      PGID: 1000
      TZ: America/New_York
      HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS: homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev,homepage.tailnet.rambtech.dev
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./homepage:/app/config
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Dashy - Alternative Dashboard
  # ==========================================================================
  dashy:
    image: lissy93/dashy:latest
    container_name: dashy
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      UID: 1000
      GID: 1000
    ports:
      - "4001:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./dashy:/app/user-data
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'node', '/app/services/healthcheck']
      interval: 1m30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Glances - System Monitoring API
  # ==========================================================================
  glances:
    image: nicolargo/glances:latest-full
    container_name: glances
    pid: host
    environment:
      - GLANCES_OPT=-w
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "61208:61208"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - /proc:/host/proc:ro
      - /sys:/host/sys:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

    environment:

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      portainer        = "10.100.1.100"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui  = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n        = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    100 = local.ip_registry.core.portainer
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  traefik_ip = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik

  _all_container_ips = concat(

    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

}

dev:dashboards:restart:
    desc: "Restart local dashboard containers (useful after config changes)"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose restart {{.SERVICE}}
      - echo "Restarted. Dashy takes ~40s to fully start."
    vars:

  # ===========================================================================
  # Homepage Widget Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  homepage:setup:
    desc: "Create homepage.env from 1Password (run after homepage:keys:create)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ENV_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage.env"
        echo "Fetching Homepage widget keys from 1Password..."

        # Check if item exists
        if ! op item get "homepage-widgets" --vault=homelab &>/dev/null; then
          echo "ERROR: 1Password item 'homepage-widgets' not found."
          echo "Run 'task homepage:keys:create' first, then add API keys to 1Password."
          exit 1
        fi

        cat > "$ENV_FILE" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        # Generated: $(date)

        HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/portainer_key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/adguard_user" 2>/dev/null || echo "admin")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/adguard_pass" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/immich_key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/jellyfin_key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/jellyseerr_key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/sonarr_key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/radarr_key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/sabnzbd_key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/qbit_user" 2>/dev/null || echo "admin")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/qbit_pass" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        EOF

        # Remove leading whitespace from heredoc
        sed -i '' 's/^        //' "$ENV_FILE"
        echo "Created $ENV_FILE"
        echo ""
        echo "Copy to dev environment:"
        echo "  cp $ENV_FILE {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards/homepage.env"

  homepage:keys:create:
    desc: "Create 1Password item template for Homepage widget API keys"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for Homepage widget keys..."
        echo ""
        echo "This creates a template item. You need to edit it and add the actual API keys."
        echo ""

        # Check if already exists
        if op item get "homepage-widgets" --vault=homelab &>/dev/null; then
          echo "Item 'homepage-widgets' already exists. Edit it with:"
          echo "  op item edit homepage-widgets --vault=homelab"
          exit 0

          'adguard_pass[password]=GET_FROM_ADGUARD' \

          'jellyfin_key[text]=GET_FROM_JELLYFIN_DASHBOARD_API_KEYS' \

          'sonarr_key[text]=GET_FROM_SONARR_SETTINGS_GENERAL' \
          'radarr_key[text]=GET_FROM_RADARR_SETTINGS_GENERAL' \
          'sabnzbd_key[text]=GET_FROM_SABNZBD_CONFIG_GENERAL' \
          'qbit_user[text]=admin' \
          'qbit_pass[password]=GET_FROM_QBITTORRENT'

        echo ""

        echo ""
        echo "Now get API keys from each service and update the item:"

        echo "  Sonarr:      https://sonarr.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General > API Key"
        echo "  Radarr:      https://radarr.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General > API Key"
        echo "  SABnzbd:     https://sabnzbd.homelab.rambtech.dev > Config > General > API Key"
        echo "  qBittorrent: https://qbittorrent.homelab.rambtech.dev (use web UI credentials)"
        echo ""
        echo "Edit the item:"
        echo "  op item edit homepage-widgets --vault=homelab portainer_key=YOUR_KEY"
        echo ""
        echo "Or edit in 1Password app directly."

  homepage:keys:show:
    desc: "Show URLs to get API keys for Homepage widgets"

        echo "=== Homepage Widget API Key Locations ==="

        echo "Service       | URL                                                    | Path to API Key"

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# =============================================================================
# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)
# =============================================================================
includes:
  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  backup:
    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  template:
    taskfile: ./tasks/template.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task tofu:apply APP=authelia' to deploy."

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")
        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"
        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"
        EOF

        echo "terraform.tfvars written to $TFVARS"

  immich-importer:cron:status:
    desc: "Show cron job status on immich-importer LXC"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- crontab -l"

  # ===========================================================================
  # IP Address Management
  # ===========================================================================

  ip:next:
    desc: "Show the next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/next.sh

  ip:list:
    desc: "Show all allocated IP addresses"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/list.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cleanup & Maintenance
  # ===========================================================================

  cleanup:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (dry run)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh

  cleanup:run:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (actually delete)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh --run

  # ===========================================================================
  # Local Development
  # ===========================================================================

  dev:dashboards:up:
    desc: "Start Homepage and Dashy locally for testing configs"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose up -d
      - |
        echo ""
        echo "=== Dashboard Dev Environment ==="
        echo ""
        echo "Homepage: http://localhost:3000"
        echo "Dashy:    http://localhost:4001"
        echo ""
        echo "Config files are mounted from tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/"
        echo "Edit configs and refresh browser to see changes."
        echo "(Dashy may need container restart for config changes)"
        echo ""
        echo "Stop with: task dev:dashboards:down"

  dev:dashboards:down:
    desc: "Stop local dashboard dev environment"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose down

  dev:dashboards:logs:
    desc: "View logs from local dashboard containers"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose logs -f {{.SERVICE}}
    vars:
      SERVICE: '{{.SERVICE | default ""}}'

  dev:dashboards:restart:
    desc: "Restart local dashboard containers (useful after config changes)"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose restart {{.SERVICE}}
      - echo "Restarted. Dashy takes ~40s to fully start."
    vars:
      SERVICE: '{{.SERVICE | default ""}}'

Now here's the workflow to set up your Homepage widgets:

## Setup Steps

**1. See where to get API keys:**
```bash
task homepage:keys:show
```

**2. Create 1Password item template:**
```bash
task homepage:keys:create
```

**3. Get API keys from each service and add to 1Password:**

| Service | URL | Location |
|---------|-----|----------|
| Portainer | https://portainer.homelab.rambtech.dev | Settings > Access tokens |
| AdGuard | https://dns.homelab.rambtech.dev | Use web UI credentials |

| Jellyfin | https://jellyfin.homelab.rambtech.dev | Dashboard > API Keys |
| Jellyseerr | https://requests.homelab.rambtech.dev | Settings > General |
| Sonarr | https://sonarr.homelab.rambtech.dev | Settings > General |
| Radarr | https://radarr.homelab.rambtech.dev | Settings > General |
| SABnzbd | https://sabnzbd.homelab.rambtech.dev | Config > General |
| qBittorrent | https://qbittorrent.homelab.rambtech.dev | Use web UI credentials |

**4. Generate homepage.env from 1Password:**
```bash
task homepage:setup
```

**5. Copy to dev and restart:**
```bash
cp tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage.env dev/dashboards/
task dev:dashboards:restart SERVICE=homepage
```

echo "=== Homepage Environment Generator ==="

if ! command -v op &> /dev/null; then

    echo "ERROR: Not signed in to 1Password. Run 'op signin' first."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Fetching API keys from 1Password..."
echo ""

# Helper function to safely read from 1Password
read_op() {
    local path="$1"
    local default="${2:-}"
    local value
    value=$(op read "$path" 2>/dev/null) || value="$default"
    echo "$value"
}

# Helper to get field from item
get_field() {
    local item="$1"
    local field="$2"
    local default="${3:-}"
    op item get "$item" --vault=homelab --fields="$field" 2>/dev/null || echo "$default"
}

# Portainer - needs API access token
echo -n "  Portainer... "
PORTAINER_KEY=$(get_field "Portainer" "api_key" "")
if [ -z "$PORTAINER_KEY" ]; then
    PORTAINER_KEY=$(get_field "Portainer" "access_token" "")

if [ -n "$PORTAINER_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no api_key or access_token field found)"
fi

    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no password found)"

echo -n "  Immich... "
IMMICH_KEY=$(get_field "immich" "api_key" "")
if [ -z "$IMMICH_KEY" ]; then
    # Try alternate field names
    IMMICH_KEY=$(get_field "immich" "homepage_key" "")
fi
if [ -n "$IMMICH_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no api_key field found - add one in 1Password)"
fi

echo -n "  Jellyfin... "
JELLYFIN_KEY=$(get_field "jellyfin" "api_key" "")
if [ -z "$JELLYFIN_KEY" ]; then
    JELLYFIN_KEY=$(get_field "Jellyfin Server" "api_key" "")

if [ -n "$JELLYFIN_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no api_key field found - create one in Jellyfin Dashboard > API Keys)"
fi

echo -n "  Jellyseerr... "
JELLYSEERR_KEY=$(get_field "jellyseerr" "api_key" "")
if [ -n "$JELLYSEERR_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no jellyseerr item or api_key field)"
fi

echo -n "  Sonarr... "
SONARR_KEY=$(get_field "sonarr" "api_key" "")
if [ -n "$SONARR_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no sonarr item or api_key field)"
fi
