echo -n "  Radarr... "
RADARR_KEY=$(get_field "radarr" "api_key" "")
if [ -n "$RADARR_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no radarr item or api_key field)"
fi

# SABnzbd - needs API key
echo -n "  SABnzbd... "
SABNZBD_KEY=$(get_field "sabnzbd" "api_key" "")
if [ -n "$SABNZBD_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no sabnzbd item or api_key field)"
fi

# qBittorrent - uses web UI credentials
echo -n "  qBittorrent... "
QBIT_USER=$(get_field "qbittorrent" "username" "admin")
QBIT_PASS=$(get_field "qbittorrent" "password" "")
if [ -n "$QBIT_PASS" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no qbittorrent item or password field)"
fi

echo ""

# Generate the env file
cat > "$OUTPUT_FILE" << EOF
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated from 1Password on $(date)
# DO NOT COMMIT THIS FILE

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=$PORTAINER_KEY

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=$ADGUARD_USER
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=$ADGUARD_PASS

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=$IMMICH_KEY

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=$JELLYFIN_KEY

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=$JELLYSEERR_KEY

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=$SONARR_KEY

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=$RADARR_KEY

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=$SABNZBD_KEY

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=$QBIT_USER
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=$QBIT_PASS
EOF

    echo "    Immich:      https://photos.homelab.rambtech.dev > Account Settings > API Keys"
else

dev:dashboards:restart:
    desc: "Restart local dashboard containers (useful after config changes)"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose restart {{.SERVICE}}
      - echo "Restarted. Dashy takes ~40s to fully start."
    vars:
      SERVICE: '{{.SERVICE | default ""}}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Homepage Widget Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  homepage:setup:
    desc: "Create homepage.env from 1Password (run after homepage:keys:create)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ENV_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage.env"
        echo "Fetching Homepage widget keys from 1Password..."

        # Check if item exists
        if ! op item get "homepage-widgets" --vault=homelab &>/dev/null; then
          echo "ERROR: 1Password item 'homepage-widgets' not found."
          echo "Run 'task homepage:keys:create' first, then add API keys to 1Password."
          exit 1
        fi

        cat > "$ENV_FILE" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        # Generated: $(date)

        HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/portainer_key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/adguard_user" 2>/dev/null || echo "admin")

toolUseResult.originalFile:
# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# =============================================================================
# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)
# =============================================================================
includes:
  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  backup:
    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  template:
    taskfile: ./tasks/template.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task tofu:apply APP=authelia' to deploy."

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh --run

        HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/adguard_user" 2>/dev/null || echo "admin")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/adguard_pass" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/homepage-widgets/immich_key" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        sed -i '' 's/^        //' "$ENV_FILE"
        echo "Created $ENV_FILE"
        echo ""
        echo "Copy to dev environment:"
        echo "  cp $ENV_FILE {{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards/homepage.env"

#!/bin/bash
# Generate homepage.env from 1Password
# Usage: ./scripts/homepage/generate-env.sh [output_path]
#
# Reads API keys from the "homepage" item in 1Password homelab vault.
# All Homepage widget API keys are stored in a single 1Password item.

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

# Default output path
OUTPUT_FILE="${1:-$PROJECT_ROOT/tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage.env}"
OP_ITEM="homepage"
OP_VAULT="homelab"

echo "=== Homepage Environment Generator ==="
echo ""

# Check 1Password CLI is available
if ! command -v op &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: 1Password CLI (op) not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Check we're signed in
if ! op account get &>/dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Not signed in to 1Password. Run 'eval \$(op signin)' first."
    exit 1
fi

# Check if item exists
if ! op item get "$OP_ITEM" --vault="$OP_VAULT" &>/dev/null; then
    echo "1Password item '$OP_ITEM' not found in vault '$OP_VAULT'."
    echo ""
    echo "Creating it now with placeholder values..."
    echo ""

    op item create --category=login --vault="$OP_VAULT" --title="$OP_ITEM" \
        'portainer_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'adguard_user[text]=admin' \
        'adguard_pass[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'immich_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'jellyfin_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'jellyseerr_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'sonarr_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'radarr_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'sabnzbd_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'qbit_user[text]=admin' \
        'qbit_pass[password]=REPLACE_ME'

    echo ""
    echo "Created '$OP_ITEM' in 1Password. Now add your API keys:"
    echo ""
    echo "  Get API keys from:"
    echo "    Portainer:   https://portainer.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > Access tokens"
    echo "    AdGuard:     https://dns.homelab.rambtech.dev (web UI credentials)"
    echo "    Immich:      https://photos.homelab.rambtech.dev > Account Settings > API Keys"
    echo "    Jellyfin:    https://jellyfin.homelab.rambtech.dev > Dashboard > API Keys"
    echo "    Jellyseerr:  https://requests.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General"
    echo "    Sonarr:      https://sonarr.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General"
    echo "    Radarr:      https://radarr.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General"
    echo "    SABnzbd:     https://sabnzbd.homelab.rambtech.dev > Config > General"
    echo "    qBittorrent: https://qbittorrent.homelab.rambtech.dev (web UI credentials)"
    echo ""
    echo "  Edit in 1Password app, or via CLI:"
    echo "    op item edit homepage --vault=homelab jellyfin_key=YOUR_KEY"
    echo ""
    echo "Then re-run this script."
    exit 0
fi

echo "Reading API keys from 1Password item: $OP_ITEM"
echo ""

# Helper to get field from item
get_field() {
    local field="$1"
    local default="${2:-}"
    op item get "$OP_ITEM" --vault="$OP_VAULT" --fields="$field" 2>/dev/null || echo "$default"
}

# Read all fields
PORTAINER_KEY=$(get_field "portainer_key" "")
ADGUARD_USER=$(get_field "adguard_user" "admin")
ADGUARD_PASS=$(get_field "adguard_pass" "")
IMMICH_KEY=$(get_field "immich_key" "")
JELLYFIN_KEY=$(get_field "jellyfin_key" "")
JELLYSEERR_KEY=$(get_field "jellyseerr_key" "")
SONARR_KEY=$(get_field "sonarr_key" "")
RADARR_KEY=$(get_field "radarr_key" "")
SABNZBD_KEY=$(get_field "sabnzbd_key" "")
QBIT_USER=$(get_field "qbit_user" "admin")
QBIT_PASS=$(get_field "qbit_pass" "")

# Generate the env file
cat > "$OUTPUT_FILE" << EOF
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated from 1Password on $(date)
# DO NOT COMMIT THIS FILE

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=$PORTAINER_KEY

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=$ADGUARD_USER
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=$ADGUARD_PASS

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=$IMMICH_KEY

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=$JELLYFIN_KEY

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=$JELLYSEERR_KEY

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=$SONARR_KEY

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=$RADARR_KEY

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=$SABNZBD_KEY

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=$QBIT_USER
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=$QBIT_PASS
EOF

echo "Generated: $OUTPUT_FILE"
echo ""

# Check for placeholder values
MISSING=0
check_key() {
    local name="$1"
    local value="$2"
    if [ -z "$value" ] || [ "$value" = "REPLACE_ME" ]; then
        echo "  ⚠ $name"
        MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
    fi
}

check_key "portainer_key" "$PORTAINER_KEY"
check_key "adguard_pass" "$ADGUARD_PASS"
check_key "immich_key" "$IMMICH_KEY"
check_key "jellyfin_key" "$JELLYFIN_KEY"
check_key "jellyseerr_key" "$JELLYSEERR_KEY"
check_key "sonarr_key" "$SONARR_KEY"
check_key "radarr_key" "$RADARR_KEY"
check_key "sabnzbd_key" "$SABNZBD_KEY"
check_key "qbit_pass" "$QBIT_PASS"

if [ "$MISSING" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "$MISSING keys still need to be set in 1Password."
    echo "Edit: op item edit homepage --vault=homelab"
else
    echo "✓ All API keys loaded!"
fi

echo ""
echo "To use in local dev:"
echo "  cp $OUTPUT_FILE $PROJECT_ROOT/dev/dashboards/homepage.env"
echo "  task dev:dashboards:restart SERVICE=homepage"

#!/bin/bash
# Generate homepage.env from 1Password
# Usage: ./scripts/homepage/generate-env.sh [output_path]
#
# Reads API keys from the "homepage" item in 1Password homelab vault.
# All Homepage widget API keys are stored in a single 1Password item.

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

# Default output path
OUTPUT_FILE="${1:-$PROJECT_ROOT/tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage.env}"
OP_ITEM="homepage"
OP_VAULT="homelab"

echo "=== Homepage Environment Generator ==="
echo ""

# Check 1Password CLI is available
if ! command -v op &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: 1Password CLI (op) not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Check we're signed in
if ! op account get &>/dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Not signed in to 1Password. Run 'eval \$(op signin)' first."
    exit 1
fi

# Check if item exists
if ! op item get "$OP_ITEM" --vault="$OP_VAULT" &>/dev/null; then
    echo "1Password item '$OP_ITEM' not found in vault '$OP_VAULT'."
    echo ""
    echo "Creating it now with placeholder values..."
    echo ""

    op item create --category=login --vault="$OP_VAULT" --title="$OP_ITEM" \
        'portainer_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'adguard_user[text]=admin' \
        'adguard_pass[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'immich_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'jellyfin_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'jellyseerr_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'sonarr_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'radarr_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'sabnzbd_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'qbit_user[text]=admin' \
        'qbit_pass[password]=REPLACE_ME'

    echo ""
    echo "Created '$OP_ITEM' in 1Password. Now add your API keys:"
    echo ""
    echo "  Get API keys from:"
    echo "    Portainer:   https://portainer.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > Access tokens"
    echo "    AdGuard:     https://dns.homelab.rambtech.dev (web UI credentials)"
    echo "    Immich:      https://photos.homelab.rambtech.dev > Account Settings > API Keys"
    echo "    Jellyfin:    https://jellyfin.homelab.rambtech.dev > Dashboard > API Keys"
    echo "    Jellyseerr:  https://requests.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General"
    echo "    Sonarr:      https://sonarr.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General"
    echo "    Radarr:      https://radarr.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General"
    echo "    SABnzbd:     https://sabnzbd.homelab.rambtech.dev > Config > General"
    echo "    qBittorrent: https://qbittorrent.homelab.rambtech.dev (web UI credentials)"
    echo ""
    echo "  Edit in 1Password app, or via CLI:"
    echo "    op item edit homepage --vault=homelab jellyfin_key=YOUR_KEY"
    echo ""
    echo "Then re-run this script."
    exit 0
fi

echo "Reading API keys from 1Password item: $OP_ITEM"
echo ""

# Helper to get field from item
get_field() {
    local field="$1"
    local default="${2:-}"
    op item get "$OP_ITEM" --vault="$OP_VAULT" --fields="$field" 2>/dev/null || echo "$default"
}

# Read all fields
PORTAINER_KEY=$(get_field "portainer_key" "")
ADGUARD_USER=$(get_field "adguard_user" "admin")
ADGUARD_PASS=$(get_field "adguard_pass" "")
IMMICH_KEY=$(get_field "immich_key" "")
JELLYFIN_KEY=$(get_field "jellyfin_key" "")
JELLYSEERR_KEY=$(get_field "jellyseerr_key" "")
SONARR_KEY=$(get_field "sonarr_key" "")
RADARR_KEY=$(get_field "radarr_key" "")
SABNZBD_KEY=$(get_field "sabnzbd_key" "")
QBIT_USER=$(get_field "qbit_user" "admin")
QBIT_PASS=$(get_field "qbit_pass" "")

# Generate the env file
cat > "$OUTPUT_FILE" << EOF
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated from 1Password on $(date)
# DO NOT COMMIT THIS FILE

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=$PORTAINER_KEY

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=$ADGUARD_USER
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=$ADGUARD_PASS

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=$IMMICH_KEY

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=$JELLYFIN_KEY

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=$JELLYSEERR_KEY

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=$SONARR_KEY

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=$RADARR_KEY

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=$SABNZBD_KEY

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=$QBIT_USER
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=$QBIT_PASS
EOF

echo "Generated: $OUTPUT_FILE"
echo ""

# Check for placeholder values
MISSING=0
check_key() {
    local name="$1"
    local value="$2"
    if [ -z "$value" ] || [ "$value" = "REPLACE_ME" ]; then
        echo "  ⚠ $name"
        MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
    fi
}

check_key "portainer_key" "$PORTAINER_KEY"
check_key "adguard_pass" "$ADGUARD_PASS"
check_key "immich_key" "$IMMICH_KEY"
check_key "jellyfin_key" "$JELLYFIN_KEY"
check_key "jellyseerr_key" "$JELLYSEERR_KEY"
check_key "sonarr_key" "$SONARR_KEY"
check_key "radarr_key" "$RADARR_KEY"
check_key "sabnzbd_key" "$SABNZBD_KEY"
check_key "qbit_pass" "$QBIT_PASS"

if [ "$MISSING" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "$MISSING keys still need to be set in 1Password."
    echo "Edit: op item edit homepage --vault=homelab"
else
    echo "✓ All API keys loaded!"
fi

echo ""
echo "To use in local dev:"
echo "  cp $OUTPUT_FILE $PROJECT_ROOT/dev/dashboards/homepage.env"
echo "  task dev:dashboards:restart SERVICE=homepage"

#!/bin/bash
# Generate homepage.env from 1Password
# Usage: ./scripts/homepage/generate-env.sh [output_path]
#
# This script fetches API keys from various 1Password items and generates
# a homepage.env file for the Homepage dashboard widgets.

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

# Default output path
OUTPUT_FILE="${1:-$PROJECT_ROOT/tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage.env}"

echo "=== Homepage Environment Generator ==="
echo ""

# Check 1Password CLI is available
if ! command -v op &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: 1Password CLI (op) not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Check we're signed in
if ! op account get &>/dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Not signed in to 1Password. Run 'op signin' first."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Fetching API keys from 1Password..."
echo ""

# Helper function to safely read from 1Password
read_op() {
    local path="$1"
    local default="${2:-}"
    local value
    value=$(op read "$path" 2>/dev/null) || value="$default"
    echo "$value"
}

# Helper to get field from item
get_field() {
    local item="$1"
    local field="$2"
    local default="${3:-}"
    op item get "$item" --vault=homelab --fields="$field" 2>/dev/null || echo "$default"
}

# Portainer - needs API access token
echo -n "  Portainer... "
PORTAINER_KEY=$(get_field "Portainer" "api_key" "")
if [ -z "$PORTAINER_KEY" ]; then
    PORTAINER_KEY=$(get_field "Portainer" "access_token" "")
fi
if [ -n "$PORTAINER_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no api_key or access_token field found)"
fi

# AdGuard - uses web UI credentials
echo -n "  AdGuard Home... "
ADGUARD_USER=$(get_field "adguard" "username" "admin")
ADGUARD_PASS=$(get_field "adguard" "password" "")
if [ -n "$ADGUARD_PASS" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no password found)"
fi

# Immich - needs API key
echo -n "  Immich... "
IMMICH_KEY=$(get_field "immich" "api_key" "")
if [ -z "$IMMICH_KEY" ]; then
    # Try alternate field names
    IMMICH_KEY=$(get_field "immich" "homepage_key" "")
fi
if [ -n "$IMMICH_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no api_key field found - add one in 1Password)"
fi

# Jellyfin - needs API key
echo -n "  Jellyfin... "
JELLYFIN_KEY=$(get_field "jellyfin" "api_key" "")
if [ -z "$JELLYFIN_KEY" ]; then
    JELLYFIN_KEY=$(get_field "Jellyfin Server" "api_key" "")
fi
if [ -n "$JELLYFIN_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no api_key field found - create one in Jellyfin Dashboard > API Keys)"
fi

# Jellyseerr - needs API key
echo -n "  Jellyseerr... "
JELLYSEERR_KEY=$(get_field "jellyseerr" "api_key" "")
if [ -n "$JELLYSEERR_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no jellyseerr item or api_key field)"
fi

# Sonarr - needs API key
echo -n "  Sonarr... "
SONARR_KEY=$(get_field "sonarr" "api_key" "")
if [ -n "$SONARR_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no sonarr item or api_key field)"
fi

# Radarr - needs API key
echo -n "  Radarr... "
RADARR_KEY=$(get_field "radarr" "api_key" "")
if [ -n "$RADARR_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no radarr item or api_key field)"
fi

# SABnzbd - needs API key
echo -n "  SABnzbd... "
SABNZBD_KEY=$(get_field "sabnzbd" "api_key" "")
if [ -n "$SABNZBD_KEY" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no sabnzbd item or api_key field)"
fi

# qBittorrent - uses web UI credentials
echo -n "  qBittorrent... "
QBIT_USER=$(get_field "qbittorrent" "username" "admin")
QBIT_PASS=$(get_field "qbittorrent" "password" "")
if [ -n "$QBIT_PASS" ]; then
    echo "✓"
else
    echo "⚠ (no qbittorrent item or password field)"
fi

echo ""

# Generate the env file
cat > "$OUTPUT_FILE" << EOF
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated from 1Password on $(date)
# DO NOT COMMIT THIS FILE

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=$PORTAINER_KEY

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=$ADGUARD_USER
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=$ADGUARD_PASS

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=$IMMICH_KEY

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=$JELLYFIN_KEY

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=$JELLYSEERR_KEY

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=$SONARR_KEY

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=$RADARR_KEY

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=$SABNZBD_KEY

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=$QBIT_USER
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=$QBIT_PASS
EOF

echo "Generated: $OUTPUT_FILE"
echo ""

# Count how many keys are missing
MISSING=0
[ -z "$PORTAINER_KEY" ] && MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
[ -z "$ADGUARD_PASS" ] && MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
[ -z "$IMMICH_KEY" ] && MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
[ -z "$JELLYFIN_KEY" ] && MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
[ -z "$JELLYSEERR_KEY" ] && MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
[ -z "$SONARR_KEY" ] && MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
[ -z "$RADARR_KEY" ] && MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
[ -z "$SABNZBD_KEY" ] && MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))

if [ "$MISSING" -gt 0 ]; then

    echo ""
    echo "  For each service, add an 'api_key' field to the existing 1Password item,"
    echo "  or create a new item with the service name (lowercase)."

# Local development compose for testing dashboard configurations
# Run with: task dev:dashboards:up
#
# For widget testing, copy homepage.env.example to homepage.env and fill in API keys

services:
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage-dev
    env_file:
      - path: ./homepage.env
        required: false
    environment:
      PUID: 1000
      PGID: 1000
      TZ: America/New_York
      HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS: localhost,127.0.0.1
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      # Mount individual config files (Homepage needs write access for logs/)
      - ../../tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage/services.yaml:/app/config/services.yaml:ro
      - ../../tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage/bookmarks.yaml:/app/config/bookmarks.yaml:ro
      - ../../tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage/widgets.yaml:/app/config/widgets.yaml:ro
      - ../../tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage/settings.yaml:/app/config/settings.yaml:ro
      # Named volume for logs/cache that Homepage needs to write
      - homepage-data:/app/config/logs
    restart: "no"

  dashy:
    image: lissy93/dashy:latest
    container_name: dashy-dev
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      UID: 1000
      GID: 1000
    ports:
      - "4001:8080"
    volumes:
      # Mount the actual config files for live editing
      - ../../tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/dashy:/app/user-data:ro
    restart: "no"
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'node', '/app/services/healthcheck']
      interval: 1m30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s

volumes:
  homepage-data:

# Local development compose for testing dashboard configurations
# Run with: task dev:dashboards:up
#
# For widget testing, copy homepage.env.example to homepage.env and fill in API keys

services:
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage-dev
    env_file:
      - path: ./homepage.env
        required: false
    environment:
      PUID: 1000
      PGID: 1000
      TZ: America/New_York
      HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS: localhost,127.0.0.1
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      # Mount individual config files (Homepage needs write access for logs/)
      - ../../tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage/services.yaml:/app/config/services.yaml:ro
      - ../../tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage/bookmarks.yaml:/app/config/bookmarks.yaml:ro
      - ../../tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage/widgets.yaml:/app/config/widgets.yaml:ro
      - ../../tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage/settings.yaml:/app/config/settings.yaml:ro
      # Named volume for logs/cache that Homepage needs to write
      - homepage-data:/app/config/logs
    restart: "no"

  dashy:
    image: lissy93/dashy:latest
    container_name: dashy-dev
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      UID: 1000
      GID: 1000
    ports:
      - "4001:8080"
    volumes:
      # Mount the actual config files for live editing
      - ../../tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/dashy:/app/user-data:ro
    restart: "no"
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'node', '/app/services/healthcheck']
      interval: 1m30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s

volumes:
  homepage-data:

#!/bin/bash
# Generate homepage.env from 1Password
# Usage: ./scripts/homepage/generate-env.sh [output_path]
#
# Reads API keys from the "homepage" item in 1Password homelab vault.
# All Homepage widget API keys are stored in a single 1Password item.

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

# Default output path
OUTPUT_FILE="${1:-$PROJECT_ROOT/tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/homepage.env}"
OP_ITEM="homepage"
OP_VAULT="homelab"

echo "=== Homepage Environment Generator ==="
echo ""

# Check 1Password CLI is available
if ! command -v op &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: 1Password CLI (op) not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Check we're signed in
if ! op account get &>/dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Not signed in to 1Password. Run 'eval \$(op signin)' first."
    exit 1
fi

# Check if item exists
if ! op item get "$OP_ITEM" --vault="$OP_VAULT" &>/dev/null; then
    echo "1Password item '$OP_ITEM' not found in vault '$OP_VAULT'."
    echo ""
    echo "Creating it now with placeholder values..."
    echo ""

    op item create --category=login --vault="$OP_VAULT" --title="$OP_ITEM" \
        'portainer_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'adguard_user[text]=admin' \
        'adguard_pass[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'immich_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'jellyfin_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'jellyseerr_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'sonarr_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'radarr_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'sabnzbd_key[password]=REPLACE_ME' \
        'qbit_user[text]=admin' \
        'qbit_pass[password]=REPLACE_ME'

    echo ""
    echo "Created '$OP_ITEM' in 1Password. Now add your API keys:"
    echo ""
    echo "  Get API keys from:"
    echo "    Portainer:   https://portainer.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > Access tokens"
    echo "    AdGuard:     https://dns.homelab.rambtech.dev (web UI credentials)"
    echo "    Immich:      https://photos.homelab.rambtech.dev > Account Settings > API Keys"
    echo "    Jellyfin:    https://jellyfin.homelab.rambtech.dev > Dashboard > API Keys"
    echo "    Jellyseerr:  https://requests.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General"
    echo "    Sonarr:      https://sonarr.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General"
    echo "    Radarr:      https://radarr.homelab.rambtech.dev > Settings > General"
    echo "    SABnzbd:     https://sabnzbd.homelab.rambtech.dev > Config > General"
    echo "    qBittorrent: https://qbittorrent.homelab.rambtech.dev (web UI credentials)"
    echo ""
    echo "  Edit in 1Password app, or via CLI:"
    echo "    op item edit homepage --vault=homelab jellyfin_key=YOUR_KEY"
    echo ""
    echo "Then re-run this script."
    exit 0
fi

echo "Reading API keys from 1Password item: $OP_ITEM"
echo ""

# Helper to get field from item
get_field() {
    local field="$1"
    local default="${2:-}"
    op item get "$OP_ITEM" --vault="$OP_VAULT" --fields="$field" 2>/dev/null || echo "$default"
}

# Read all fields
PORTAINER_KEY=$(get_field "portainer_key" "")
ADGUARD_USER=$(get_field "adguard_user" "admin")
ADGUARD_PASS=$(get_field "adguard_pass" "")
IMMICH_KEY=$(get_field "immich_key" "")
JELLYFIN_KEY=$(get_field "jellyfin_key" "")
JELLYSEERR_KEY=$(get_field "jellyseerr_key" "")
SONARR_KEY=$(get_field "sonarr_key" "")
RADARR_KEY=$(get_field "radarr_key" "")
SABNZBD_KEY=$(get_field "sabnzbd_key" "")
QBIT_USER=$(get_field "qbit_user" "admin")
QBIT_PASS=$(get_field "qbit_pass" "")

# Generate the env file
cat > "$OUTPUT_FILE" << EOF
# Homepage Widget API Keys
# Auto-generated from 1Password on $(date)
# DO NOT COMMIT THIS FILE

# Portainer: Settings > Access tokens
HOMEPAGE_VAR_PORTAINER_KEY=$PORTAINER_KEY

# AdGuard Home: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_USER=$ADGUARD_USER
HOMEPAGE_VAR_ADGUARD_PASS=$ADGUARD_PASS

# Immich: Account Settings > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_IMMICH_KEY=$IMMICH_KEY

# Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYFIN_KEY=$JELLYFIN_KEY

# Jellyseerr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_JELLYSEERR_KEY=$JELLYSEERR_KEY

# Sonarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SONARR_KEY=$SONARR_KEY

# Radarr: Settings > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_RADARR_KEY=$RADARR_KEY

# SABnzbd: Config > General
HOMEPAGE_VAR_SABNZBD_KEY=$SABNZBD_KEY

# qBittorrent: Web UI credentials
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_USER=$QBIT_USER
HOMEPAGE_VAR_QBIT_PASS=$QBIT_PASS
EOF

echo "Generated: $OUTPUT_FILE"
echo ""

# Check for placeholder values
MISSING=0
check_key() {
    local name="$1"
    local value="$2"
    if [ -z "$value" ] || [ "$value" = "REPLACE_ME" ]; then
        echo "  ⚠ $name"
        MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
    fi
}

check_key "portainer_key" "$PORTAINER_KEY"
check_key "adguard_pass" "$ADGUARD_PASS"
check_key "immich_key" "$IMMICH_KEY"
check_key "jellyfin_key" "$JELLYFIN_KEY"
check_key "jellyseerr_key" "$JELLYSEERR_KEY"
check_key "sonarr_key" "$SONARR_KEY"
check_key "radarr_key" "$RADARR_KEY"
check_key "sabnzbd_key" "$SABNZBD_KEY"
check_key "qbit_pass" "$QBIT_PASS"

if [ "$MISSING" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "$MISSING keys still need to be set in 1Password."
    echo "Edit: op item edit homepage --vault=homelab"
else
    echo "✓ All API keys loaded!"
fi

echo ""
echo "To use in local dev:"
echo "  cp $OUTPUT_FILE $PROJECT_ROOT/dev/dashboards/homepage.env"
echo "  task dev:dashboards:restart SERVICE=homepage"

# Traefik v3 static configuration for homelab
global:
  checkNewVersion: false
  sendAnonymousUsage: false

api:
  dashboard: true
  debug: false
  insecure: false

# Prometheus metrics endpoint
metrics:

    entryPoint: metrics
    addEntryPointsLabels: true
    addRoutersLabels: true
    addServicesLabels: true

entryPoints:

    address: ":80"
  websecure:

      tls:
        certResolver: letsencrypt
  metrics:
    address: ":8082"

providers:
  file:
    directory: "/config/dynamic"
    watch: true

# Traefik v3 syntax for certificate resolvers
certificatesResolvers:
  letsencrypt:
    acme:
      email: darshanrambhia@live.com
      storage: /config/certs/acme.json
      dnsChallenge:
        provider: cloudflare
        resolvers:
          - "1.1.1.1:53"
          - "1.0.0.1:53"
        delayBeforeCheck: 60s

log:
  level: INFO
  filePath: "/config/logs/traefik.log"

accessLog:
  filePath: "/config/logs/access.log"

serversTransport:
  insecureSkipVerify: true

# Traefik - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/

name: traefik

services:
  traefik:
    container_name: traefik
    image: traefik:v3.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"        # HTTP
      - "443:443"      # HTTPS
      - "8082:8082"    # Metrics
    environment:
      - CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${CF_DNS_API_TOKEN}
      - CF_API_EMAIL=${CF_API_EMAIL}
    volumes:
      # Static config (synced by docker-host module to /config/static/)
      - /config/static/traefik.yml:/etc/traefik/traefik.yml:ro
      # Dynamic configs (synced by docker-host module to /config/dynamic/)
      - /config/dynamic:/config/dynamic:ro
      # Certificates (Docker volume for persistence across restarts)
      - certs:/config/certs
      # Logs (Docker volume)
      - logs:/config/logs
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "traefik", "healthcheck", "--ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # Portainer Agent for remote management
  portainer-agent:
    container_name: portainer_agent
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    ports:
      - 9001:9001
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  certs:
  logs:

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      portainer        = "10.100.1.100"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui  = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n        = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    100 = local.ip_registry.core.portainer
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC
  traefik_ip = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

output "container_ips" {

}

# Media Management Stack
# VPN-protected download clients + library managers
# Following TRaSH Guides best practices

name: media-management

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Gluetun - VPN Gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)
  # ==========================================================================
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:latest
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=nordvpn
      - VPN_TYPE=wireguard
      - WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=${NORDVPN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - SERVER_COUNTRIES=Netherlands
      - TZ=America/New_York
      # Allow access to local network (for Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr on host network)
      - FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24
      # Health check settings
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_INITIAL=30s
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_ADDITION=10s
    ports:
      # qBittorrent
      - "8080:8080"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
      # Prowlarr
      - "9696:9696"
      # FlareSolverr
      - "8191:8191"
    volumes:
      - gluetun-data:/gluetun
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- ifconfig.me || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # qBittorrent - BitTorrent Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    container_name: qbittorrent
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - WEBUI_PORT=8080
    volumes:
      - qbittorrent-config:/config
      - /data/torrents:/data/torrents
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prowlarr - Indexer Manager (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  prowlarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:latest
    container_name: prowlarr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - prowlarr-config:/config
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # FlareSolverr - Cloudflare Bypass (via VPN, optional)
  # ==========================================================================
  flaresolverr:
    image: ghcr.io/flaresolverr/flaresolverr:latest
    container_name: flaresolverr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
      - LOG_HTML=false
      - CAPTCHA_SOLVER=none
      - TZ=America/New_York
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Sonarr - TV Show Management
  # ==========================================================================
  sonarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:latest
    container_name: sonarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sonarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Radarr - Movie Management
  # ==========================================================================
  radarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:latest
    container_name: radarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - radarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Lidarr - Music Management
  # ==========================================================================
  lidarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/lidarr:latest
    container_name: lidarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - lidarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Bazarr - Subtitle Management
  # ==========================================================================
  bazarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bazarr:latest
    container_name: bazarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - bazarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # SABnzbd - Usenet Download Client
  # ==========================================================================
  sabnzbd:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sabnzbd:latest
    container_name: sabnzbd
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sabnzbd-config:/config
      - /data/usenet:/data/usenet
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Recyclarr - TRaSH Guides Sync
  # ==========================================================================
  recyclarr:
    image: ghcr.io/recyclarr/recyclarr:latest
    container_name: recyclarr
    network_mode: host
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - RECYCLARR_CREATE_CONFIG=true
    volumes:
      - ./recyclarr:/config
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  gluetun-data:
  qbittorrent-config:
  prowlarr-config:
  sonarr-config:
  radarr-config:
  lidarr-config:
  bazarr-config:
  sabnzbd-config:

The user has a point. Looking at the docker-compose.yml, SABnzbd is currently configured with `network_mode: host` instead of going through gluetun. Whether SABnzbd should go through the VPN depends on your use case:

1. **Through VPN (gluetun)**: If your usenet provider requires VPN, or you want to hide your IP from the provider
2. **Host network (current)**: If your usenet provider doesn't require VPN (most don't since usenet traffic is SSL encrypted), this gives direct faster access

For the **Homepage widget** purpose, the current setup works - SABnzbd is accessible on port 8085 from the host network. If you want to move SABnzbd behind gluetun, that would be a separate infrastructure change to the docker-compose.yml.

# Media Management Stack
# VPN-protected download clients + library managers
# Following TRaSH Guides best practices

name: media-management

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Gluetun - VPN Gateway (NordVPN WireGuard)
  # ==========================================================================
  gluetun:
    image: qmcgaw/gluetun:latest
    container_name: gluetun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    environment:
      - VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=nordvpn
      - VPN_TYPE=wireguard
      - WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=${NORDVPN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY}
      - SERVER_COUNTRIES=Netherlands
      - TZ=America/New_York
      # Allow access to local network (for Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr on host network)
      - FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24
      # Health check settings
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_INITIAL=30s
      - HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_ADDITION=10s
    ports:
      # qBittorrent
      - "8080:8080"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"
      # Prowlarr
      - "9696:9696"
      # FlareSolverr
      - "8191:8191"
    volumes:
      - gluetun-data:/gluetun
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- ifconfig.me || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # qBittorrent - BitTorrent Client (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    container_name: qbittorrent
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - WEBUI_PORT=8080
    volumes:
      - qbittorrent-config:/config
      - /data/torrents:/data/torrents
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prowlarr - Indexer Manager (via VPN)
  # ==========================================================================
  prowlarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/prowlarr:latest
    container_name: prowlarr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - prowlarr-config:/config
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # FlareSolverr - Cloudflare Bypass (via VPN, optional)
  # ==========================================================================
  flaresolverr:
    image: ghcr.io/flaresolverr/flaresolverr:latest
    container_name: flaresolverr
    network_mode: "service:gluetun"
    environment:
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
      - LOG_HTML=false
      - CAPTCHA_SOLVER=none
      - TZ=America/New_York
    depends_on:
      gluetun:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Sonarr - TV Show Management
  # ==========================================================================
  sonarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:latest
    container_name: sonarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - sonarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Radarr - Movie Management
  # ==========================================================================
  radarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/radarr:latest
    container_name: radarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - radarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Lidarr - Music Management
  # ==========================================================================
  lidarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/lidarr:latest
    container_name: lidarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - lidarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Bazarr - Subtitle Management
  # ==========================================================================
  bazarr:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/bazarr:latest
    container_name: bazarr
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - bazarr-config:/config
      - /data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # SABnzbd - Usenet Download Client
  # ==========================================================================
  sabnzbd:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/sabnzbd:latest
    container_name: sabnzbd
    network_mode: host

      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

    image: ghcr.io/recyclarr/recyclarr:latest
    container_name: recyclarr
    network_mode: host
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - RECYCLARR_CREATE_CONFIG=true
    volumes:
      - ./recyclarr:/config
    restart: unless-stopped

  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================

    image: portainer/agent:latest

      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/New_York

SABnzbd is now running through gluetun VPN on port 8085. The Homepage widget config already has the correct port (8085), so no changes needed there.

**Summary of changes:**

Updated [docker-compose.yml](tofu/apps/media-management/deploy/docker-compose.yml):
- SABnzbd now uses `network_mode: "service:gluetun"` instead of `host`
- Added `depends_on: gluetun` with health check condition
- Added port 8085 mapping to gluetun container

Both download clients (qBittorrent and SABnzbd) are now routed through the VPN for privacy.
isn't bazaar also a download client that should be running through gluetun?

Bazarr is actually a **subtitle management** tool, not a download client. It fetches subtitles from providers like OpenSubtitles, Subscene, etc. - it doesn't download media files.

However, you raise a valid point - subtitle providers can also track your IP. If you want privacy for subtitle downloads too, it could go through gluetun. But there are trade-offs:

**Current (host network):**
- Direct access to Sonarr/Radarr on localhost (faster communication)
- Subtitle providers see your real IP

**Through gluetun:**
- Subtitle providers see VPN IP
- Needs to reach Sonarr/Radarr via container network or LAN IP instead of localhost

The *arr stack (Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Bazarr) typically runs on host network because they need to communicate with each other and access the filesystem directly. They're library managers, not download clients.

The services that truly need VPN protection are:
- **qBittorrent** - torrent traffic exposes your IP to peers
- **SABnzbd** - usenet traffic (though SSL encrypted, some prefer VPN)
- **Prowlarr** - indexer queries (optional, but helps with privacy)

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Glances
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201
# IP: 192.168.1.234
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 201
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dashboards Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "dashboards"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Dashboards"
  service_description = "Homepage and Dashy dashboard applications with system monitoring"

  service_urls = {
    homepage_internal = "https://homepage.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_internal    = "https://dashy.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_public      = "https://dashy.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Homepage", port = 3000, info = "Main dashboard" },
    { name = "Dashy", port = 4001, info = "Alternative dashboard" },
    { name = "Glances", port = 61208, info = "System monitoring API" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f homepage
cd /config && docker compose logs -f dashy
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart homepage
cd /config && docker compose restart dashy
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=dashboards` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["dashboards", "homepage", "dashy", "monitoring"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Homepage route (internal only)
module "homepage_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "homepage"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "homepage.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# Dashy route (internal + public)
module "dashy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "dashy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route (via Cloudflare tunnel)
  public_domain = "dashy.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.dashboards]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.dashboards.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.dashboards.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.dashboards.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    homepage_internal = module.homepage_route.internal_url
    dashy_internal    = module.dashy_route.internal_url
    dashy_public      = module.dashy_route.public_url
    direct_homepage   = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:3000"
    direct_dashy      = "http://${module.dashboards.ip_address}:4001"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    homepage = module.homepage_route.remote_config_path
    dashy    = module.dashy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network - dual-network architecture
  container_ip      = var.container_ip
  container_gateway = var.container_gateway
  lan_ip            = var.lan_ip
  lan_gateway       = var.lan_gateway

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = split("/", var.container_ip)[0]
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory, excluding specified patterns
locals {
  _all_deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []

  # Filter out files matching exclude patterns
  deploy_files = [
    for f in local._all_deploy_files : f
    if !anytrue([for pattern in var.exclude_patterns : can(regex(pattern, f))])
  ]
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = toset(local.deploy_files)

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0644"

  # SSH configuration - provider config is inherited but explicit for clarity
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = each.value

  # SSH configuration
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: Docker Compose stack deployment is handled by the deploy directory
# containing docker-compose.yml. The filesync provider syncs the compose file
# to the container. Applications can manually run `docker compose up -d` via
# SSH if needed, or include it in post_sync_commands.

# =============================================================================
# 1Password Provider Configuration
# =============================================================================
# This file provides direct 1Password integration for secret management.
# Secrets are fetched at plan/apply time using the 1Password CLI.
#
# Authentication: Uses 1Password CLI with biometric unlock
# Ensure `op` CLI v2.23.0+ is installed and signed in
#
# Usage: Symlink this file to any app that needs 1Password secrets
#   ln -s ../../../onepassword.tf tofu/apps/<app>/onepassword.tf
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password Vault Reference
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_vault" "homelab" {
  name = "homelab"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Core Infrastructure Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# OpenTofu state encryption and Proxmox credentials
data "onepassword_item" "opentofu" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "opentofu"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "cloudflare" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "Cloudflare"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "grafana" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "grafana"
}

data "onepassword_item" "discord_webhook" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "discord-alertmanager-webhook"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper Locals - Flatten 1Password fields for easy access
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The 1Password provider returns fields in a nested structure.
# Custom fields are inside section blocks.

locals {
  # Flatten all section fields from opentofu item into a map by label
  _opentofu_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.opentofu.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # Flatten all section fields from cloudflare item into a map by label
  _cloudflare_section_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.cloudflare.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  # 1Password secrets - access via local.op.<secret_name>
  op = {
    # State encryption passphrase (main password field)
    state_encryption_passphrase = data.onepassword_item.opentofu.password

    # Proxmox API token (custom field in section)
    proxmox_api_token = lookup(local._opentofu_section_fields, "proxmox_api_token", "")

    # Cloudflare tokens (custom fields in sections)
    cloudflare_tunnel_token = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "tunnel_token", "")
    cloudflare_api_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "ddns_api_token", lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", ""))
    cloudflare_dns_token    = lookup(local._cloudflare_section_fields, "Api token - traefik", "")

    # Monitoring
    grafana_admin_password = data.onepassword_item.grafana.password
    discord_webhook_url    = data.onepassword_item.discord_webhook.credential
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Dashboards LXC - Homepage + Dashy + Glances
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 201
# IP: 192.168.1.234
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 201
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dashboards Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "dashboards" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "dashboards"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Dashboards"
  service_description = "Homepage and Dashy dashboard applications with system monitoring"

  service_urls = {
    homepage_internal = "https://homepage.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_internal    = "https://dashy.${var.domain_internal}"
    dashy_public      = "https://dashy.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Homepage", port = 3000, info = "Main dashboard" },
    { name = "Dashy", port = 4001, info = "Alternative dashboard" },
    { name = "Glances", port = 61208, info = "System monitoring API" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f homepage
cd /config && docker compose logs -f dashy
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart homepage
cd /config && docker compose restart dashy
```

## Managed by OpenTofu
